contentHtml:
The visa cancellation letter in the UAE stands as a crucial document for expatriates seeking to permanently exit the country. This formal letter, managed by sponsors, signifies the termination of one’s Residence Visa. For those in the UAE on a Residence Visa, cancellation is a mandatory step before leaving.

In this article, we explore the nuances of the UAE visa cancellation process, shedding light on its significance and the specific procedures involved. Understanding the essence of the visa cancellation letter is paramount for a seamless departure from the UAE.

What Does the Visa Cancellation Letter Mean?

The visa cancellation letter, a pivotal document, holds significant importance for expatriates in the UAE, guiding their departure process. This letter serves as a formal acknowledgment and declaration of the termination of one’s Residence Visa.

Overall, the significance of visa cancellation letter is as following:

  • It highlights the end date of your UAE stay.
  • It has a legal value for all the individuals who want to go back to their homeland.
  • It is important document that depicts the process Residence Visa cancelation has been approved and started.

The employee visa cancellation letter in UAE has a specific protocol that needs to be followed that is initiated by the employer. The employer also requests cancelation of work permit, as it is necessary to Residence Visa cancellation in the UAE.

How Long Do You Need to Wait for Visa Cancellation?

The duration for visa cancellation letter processing in the UAE is a common concern among expatriates. If you are asking, “how many days for the cancellation of a visa in the UAE?” rest assured, it is a streamlined process.

Cancelling the labour card typically takes just 1 working day, while the broader UAE visa cancellation takes 1 to 2 working days. Employees eager to proceed with their plans often inquire about “how many days for a visa cancellation in the UAE?” Fortunately, the entire procedure typically wraps up within a week.

However, the timeline may vary slightly depending on the specific type of visa. Understanding this timeline provides clarity and reassurance for individuals awaiting the completion of their visa cancellation letter UAE. Also, if urgency is a concern, it is worth noting that certain types of visas may require a bit more time for cancellation, ensuring expatriates are well-informed and can plan accordingly.

When Is the Right Time to Cancel Your UAE Visa?

It is really important to know the most accurate time to initiate UAE visa cancellation process. It helps in transition to make it seamless and smooth as the process involves the visa cancellation letter submission to employer or your sponsor.

The expiration date of the employment contract indicates the most accurate moment to process your cancelation of UAE visa. You have to issue a nonrenewal letter if you do not want to extend your employment contract along with the visa cancellation letter request at least 30 days prior to the ending of contract.

By adhering to this timeline, you provide ample time for the HR team to process your cancellation. Therefore, this proactive approach prevents fines for overstaying, ensuring a smooth settlement of end-of-service pay and other benefits.

Moreover, you can plan your next moves soon after submitting your visa cancellation request such as considering the options like freelance or tourist visa.

Why Is It Necessary to Get a Visa Cancellation Letter?

The necessity of a visa cancellation letter is because it enables the smooth take off from the UAE. When an employee or individual plans to depart or alter visa status, requesting a visa cancellation letter becomes crucial for compliance. This document is not just a formality; it is a formal request to the employer, indicating the intent to end employment and cancel the associated visa.

So why to obtain a cancellation letter for a visa? The reasons are as following:

  • To avoid unnecessary legal consequences
  • To avoid financial penalties and fines
  • To protect yourself from a permanent labor ban
  • To provide your employer a clear timeline for your departure
  • To enable HR or your company to manage efficiently the process of cancellation
  • To help your company with the calculation of end-of-service benefits
  • To process the paperwork necessary for going back
  • To ensure a lawful and well-organized transition
  • To stay compliant with the legal requirements

Moreover, the cancellation letter plays a crucial role in providing a clear timeline for the employee’s departure. It allows the HR team to efficiently manage the cancellation process, calculate end-of-service benefits, and process the necessary paperwork.

In addition, the timely issuance of a visa cancellation letter allows employees to plan their next steps, whether it involves leaving the country, applying for a new visa, or exploring alternative opportunities within the UAE.

In summary, obtaining a visa cancellation letter is necessary to comply with legal requirements, avoid financial penalties, and ensure a well-organized and lawful transition for both employers and employees in the UAE.

How Can You Cancel a Visa in UAE If You Are an Employee?

Canceling your UAE visa as an employee is a straightforward process, and issuing a visa cancellation letter is a crucial step in this procedure. Here is a concise guide:

  1. Prepare Your Cancellation Letter: Write a clear and formal visa cancellation request letter addressed to your employer.
  2. Download the Application: Download the visa cancellation application form either online or from a service center.
  3. Seek Employer’s Approval: Request your employer’s signature on the application, indicating their approval for the cancellation.
  4. Submit Documentation: Provide the necessary documentation required for the cancellation process.
  5. End-of-Service Processing: The HR team will process your end-of-service entitlement.
  6. Ministry of Labor and GDRFA: The Ministry of Labor will cancel your labor card, and the information will be forwarded to the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA).
  7. Residence Visa Cancellation: Your employer, either in person or online, will visit the GDRFA to cancel the residence visa.
  8. Check Visa Cancellation Status: After completion, check your visa cancellation status in the UAE to ensure the process is finalized.

How Can You Cancel the Family Visa for Your Dependents?

Canceling a family visa for dependents in the UAE is a straightforward process. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit Authorized Typing Centre: Go to an authorized typing center or immigration office to obtain the visa cancellation request letter form.
  2. Provide Necessary Documents: Submit the cancellation form along with your dependents’ original passport and your original Emirates ID card.
  3. Authorized Centre Processing: The authorized centre will process the cancellation on your behalf, making the process convenient for you.
  4. Timely Cancellation: Ensure that this process is completed before your employment visa, as the sponsor, is canceled.
  5. Choose Between Online or Centre:  Opt for either online processing through the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) website or visit a registered typing centre.
  6. Online Processing:  If you choose online processing, enter the GDRFA website or the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship.

Who Has the Authority to Stop a UAE Visa?

Understanding the authority for canceling a UAE visa is crucial, and the process varies based on the type of visa.

For an employment visa, the employee holds the authority. They can initiate the cancellation by submitting a formal visa cancellation letter to their employer. In the case of a family visa, the individual sponsoring dependents is responsible for canceling their visas. As for a freelance visa, individuals act as their own sponsors, holding the authority for cancellation.

Moreover, once the sponsor completes the visa cancellation, individuals can check the UAE visa cancellation status for confirmation. Therefore, to avoid all types of complications in legal processes, you have to follow the procedures correctly.

You should be clear on who has the authority of the each type of visa cancelation can help you go through the process effectively, and facilitate you with a hassle-free compliance with the law in the UAE.

How Can You Write a Visa Cancellation Letter?

If you want to write a visa cancellation letter, it involves the submission of:

  • Essential documents
  • The sponsor-signed UAE visa cancellation form
  • The original passport
  • Emirates ID card
  • Approval certificate from the MOHRE (Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation)

Overall, writing a visa cancellation letter is a straightforward process. Follow these steps for an effective document:

  1. Provide Personal Information  in the letter that includes name, your address, and your contact details.
  2. Mention the Company Details with the name of the company and address.
  3. Write Down the Job Information that specifies job position, service years, and the termination date.
  4. Provide The Reasons for Cancellation for requesting the visa cancellation process.
  5. Opt For Formal Formatting to structure your visa cancellation letter.
  6. Address The Recipient With A Proper Title, such as “Respected Sir” or “Dear Concerns”
  7. Justified Letter Content for a well-polished look and appearance.
  8. Formal Conclusion should be added for farewell words in letter.

What is the Cost of a UAE Visa Cancellation?

The cost for visa cancellation letter ranges from AED 100 to AED 200. Sponsor has to bear these expenses to cover all the charges for administrative tasks for cancellation process. Understanding the financial aspect of visa cancellation letter is crucial for individuals planning their departure from the UAE.

FAQs

How do I write a UAE visa cancellation letter?

A UAE visa cancellation letter should be formal and addressed to the concerned immigration authority. It must include your full name, passport number, visa details, and a clear request to cancel the visa. The letter should also include your reason for cancellation and the employer’s or sponsor’s signature, if applicable.

What is the process to cancel a UAE visa?

The visa sponsor must submit a cancellation request through the official immigration or MOHRE portal, whether an employer or a free zone authority. After approval, the visa holder must return their Emirates ID and passport for visa stamping removal. The process can be completed online or at a typing centre.

What are the latest visa cancellation rules in the UAE?

In 2025, all residence and employment visas must be cancelled before the employee or resident leaves the country or switches sponsors. Employers must clear pending dues, and visa holders are granted a grace period to either exit or change their visa status after cancellation.

What details must be included in a visa cancellation letter?

The letter should contain your name, passport number, visa number, Emirates ID number, company or sponsor name, and a statement requesting visa cancellation. It must also mention the date and include the applicant’s or sponsor’s signature.

What is the cancellation fee and processing time in the UAE?

The cancellation fee typically ranges from AED 100 to AED 200. Processing usually takes 1 to 3 working days if all documents are correctly submitted and there are no pending issues with the sponsor.

How long can I stay in the UAE after my visa is cancelled?

After cancellation, most visa holders get a grace period of 30 days to either leave the country, renew their visa, or apply for a new one. Certain categories, like investors or freelancers, may receive up to 60 to 180 days, depending on their visa type.
